one_line: Pala ruler of Bengal–Bihar who fought for influence over Kanauj during the Tripartite Struggle.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, medium-tall, sturdy build with a calm but authoritative bearing.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, medium-full lips, warm wheat-brown complexion, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard framing the jaw, arched brows and sharp, observant eyes; default expression is composed and thoughtful, with a hint of stern resolve.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a high, neatly tied topknot at the back of the crown, with a smooth, clean forehead; a simple gold circlet-style mukuta with a small central lotus motif sits low on the brow, and a narrow cloth band (maroon) wraps under the knot.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate eastern Indian royal attire: a knee-length, wrapped cotton-silk uttariya in deep maroon worn as a fitted upper garment with short, snug sleeves, bordered in gold; below, a cream-colored, finely pleated ankle-length dhoti with a broad gold border, wrapped in the Bengal/Pala style and tied securely at the waist with a dark maroon sash; over the shoulders a light saffron silk shawl (uttariya) with subtle repeating lotus patterns hangs symmetrically, one end draped over the left shoulder and the other over the right forearm; his feet wear simple but elegant brown leather sandals; jewellery consists of a pair of medium-thick gold hoop earrings, two layered gold necklaces (one short collar with a small circular pendant, one longer to mid-chest), a pair of plain gold armlets above the biceps, and a single broad gold bracelet on his right wrist; the overall textile feel is rich but not over-ornate, in keeping with Pala taste, with restrained patterning—thin horizontal gold stripes near the edges of dhoti and shawl.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly curved steel sword with a plain broad blade and a simple yet dignified hilt: straight crossguard, rounded pommel, and a grip wrapped in dark brown leather; the sword is sheathed in a dark brown scabbard with gold fittings and hangs from a maroon leather belt worn over his sash, usually held lightly in his left hand when posed.

ref_desc: Dharmapala is a wheat-brown, oval-faced man in his 40s with a black topknot, neat moustache and beard, wearing a maroon upper wrap, cream ankle-length dhoti with gold borders, saffron shawl, simple gold jewellery, and carrying a curved steel sword in a dark brown scabbard with gold fittings.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Dharmapala of the Pala Dynasty: a medium-tall, sturdy man in his late 30s–early 40s with a warm wheat-brown complexion, oval face, straight nose, arched brows, sharp observant eyes, and a neatly trimmed moustache and short beard framing his jaw, his thick black hair tied in a high topknot at the back of the crown and encircled by a simple gold circlet-mukuta with a small central lotus motif and a maroon cloth band under the knot. Show him in rich but restrained eastern Indian royal attire from c. 8th–9th century: a fitted deep maroon wrapped cotton-silk upper garment with short sleeves and a fine gold border, a finely pleated cream ankle-length dhoti with broad gold border wrapped in Bengal style, secured at the waist with a dark maroon sash, and a light saffron silk shawl with subtle repeating lotus patterns draped symmetrically over both shoulders, one end hanging over the left shoulder and the other resting over the right forearm. Add simple but dignified gold jewellery: medium-thick gold hoop earrings, two layered gold necklaces (one short with a small circular pendant, one longer to mid-chest), plain gold armlets on his upper arms, and a single broad gold bracelet on his right wrist; put brown leather sandals on his feet. His signature weapon is a long slightly curved steel sword with a plain broad blade, straight crossguard, rounded pommel and a dark brown leather-wrapped grip, in a dark brown scabbard with gold fittings hanging from a maroon leather belt over his sash; have him lightly resting his left hand on the hilt. Use a palette dominated by deep maroon, cream, saffron, gold and dark brown, and present multiple views (front, side, back) plus a close-up of his face and topknot to emphasize consistent hair, costume details and sword design.
